target.name: Virtus Stone Harbor Emerging Markets Total Income Fund

acquirer.name: Virtus Stone Harbor Emerging Markets Income Fund

announcement.quote: The Board of Trustees of the Acquired Fund has approved the reorganization of the Acquired Fund with and into Virtus Stone Harbor Emerging Markets Income Fund (the “Acquiring Fund” and, together with the Acquired Fund, the “Funds”).

deals.notes: Both funds are described as closed-end management investment companies, but no exchange or ticker is shown for either, so listing is not settled. The agreement allows termination if closing has not occurred on or before February 4, 2024. The 2024 and 2025 DEF 14A excerpts are annual-meeting notices and do not mention the outcome.
